scope_note: Classification is based on repository wiring, local compose definitions, adapters, tests, evidence artifacts, and dashboard-visible signals in this checkout.

classification_rubric.used_now: Actively contributes to the current governed runtime or evidence path.
classification_rubric.partially_used: Present through containers, configs, adapters, tests, or policy bridges, but not yet a proven mandatory path element.
classification_rubric.optional_future: Kept in scope for future depth only; current reviewer outcomes do not depend on it.
classification_rubric.reference_only: Vendored source snapshot retained for compatibility or implementation reference, not for active architecture claims.

components.runtime_role: Primary governed AI runtime target reached behind dashboard-controlled handoffs.
components.necessity_rationale: It is the only upstream runtime the repo actively proves through governed handoff flows, runtime entry points, and reviewer evidence.
governance_signals: Recent Onyx handoff outcomes on the homepage
Onyx activity entries in the live activity feed
components.missing_integration_depth: The repo proves governed handoff and activity visibility, but not a full Onyx-in-compose production path in the default control-plane stack.
components.removal_impact: Removes the only real upstream runtime target, breaks governed handoff flows, and invalidates the repo's Onyx-focused integration tests.
components.status_notes: Onyx is intentionally not the homepage; it remains the governed runtime module behind the dashboard entry flow.

components.runtime_role: Evidence-plane trace store and live observability destination when traces are available.
components.necessity_rationale: It gives the dashboard a real runtime activity source beyond static artifacts and anchors the evidence-plane story in something live.
governance_signals: Langfuse trace and session activity in the live activity feed
Trace-derived operational visibility for governed runtime behavior
components.missing_integration_depth: The repo has a real bridge and dashboard polling, but governed-flow artifacts are not comprehensively exported into Langfuse on every path yet.
components.removal_impact: Removes live trace and session visibility from the dashboard and weakens evidence-plane drill-downs tied to runtime activity.
components.status_notes: Treat Langfuse as part of the evidence path, not as the homepage or the source of truth for every governance artifact.
